 Q-Lab Co-Organizing and Attending the Automotive Corrosion Symposium 
Q-Lab Co-Organizing and Attending the Automotive Corrosion Symposium
Blog
Last Updated 2023
Q-Lab's Sean Fowler is one of the organizers for the upcoming Automotive Corrosion Symposium, presented by the Southwest Research Institute (SwRI) and held in Detroit, MI on 31 Mar and 01 Apr. This exciting event brings together industry experts from automotive OEMs, material suppliers, paint suppliers and Tier 1 suppliers to foster communication within the automotive industry and address industry-wide corrosion issues.
Sean notes that, "In Europe, there are venues for the automotive industry to discuss corrosion issues, but there haven't been in regular events like this in North America. AMPP (formerly NACE) holds great technical symposia, but the topics are very broad and focused on other industries. A few years ago, RISE KIMAB of Sweden organized a successful automotive corrosion symposium in the U.S., and some of us from the corrosion testing community felt that we should take up the effort and organize one using U.S. resources. Hopefully, some momentum comes from the event and we can hold these at least every other year going forward."
The 15 featured talks at the event feature presentations by corrosion experts from:
General Motors
Ford
Axalta
The Ohio State University
Texas A&M University
SwRI
Luna Labs
Edison Welding Institute
PPG
University of Tulsa
George Mason University

 Corrosion Testing
 Florida Natural Outdoor 
Florida Natural Outdoor Testing
Natural outdoor corrosion testing gives the most realistic prediction of product performance. Q-Lab offers outdoor corrosion exposure testing at our location in Florida. Corrosion exposure in Florida is realistic and accelerated, and is the best way to verify laboratory test results. Q-Lab also provides all users with climate data to enhance interpretation of materials durability test results. See our Outdoor Testing brochure for more information on these sites and our Testing Services brochure to learn about our full range of weathering testing services.
Why Test in Florida?
Florida has high-intensity sunlight, year-round high temperatures, high annual rainfall, and high humidity. When combined, these factors create the harsh climate that makes Florida the ideal location for testing exterior durability. Q‑Lab Florida, located south of Miami, is the only true subtropical region in the continental United States, and has more specimens on test than any other outdoor weathering facility in the world.  We offer natural outdoor exposure testing, accelerated laboratory testing, and specimen evaluation services at Q‑Lab Florida.
Florida Corrosion Testing
Florida is the internationally-recognized benchmark location for outdoor weathering exposure testing. Although Q-Lab Florida is far enough inland to avoid being a true marine environment, the high-intensity sunlight, high annual UV, high year-round temperatures, abundant rainfall, and very high humidity still cause rapid outdoor property changes.
Florida exposures can test for corrosion behavior of paints, coatings, anodization, galvanization, and other protective strategies for metals.
Why Florida?
Florida Corrosion Exposure Techniques
Direct Exposure
Direct exposures are used to test many exterior-use materials, such as industrial coatings. Specimens are securely mounted with their front surface facing the sun. Different exposure angles and mounting methods are used for different applications.
Direct Exposures
Salt-Accelerated Outdoor Corrosion
Direct exposures with salt spray can produce fast and realistic corrosion, particularly for coated metals. Specimens in salt-accelerated corrosion tests are sprayed with a salt solution twice per week to better simulate marine environments.
Marine Salt Fog Testing

Accelerated Laboratory Corrosion Testing Services
For those who are interested in accelerated corrosion testing but are not yet ready to purchase Q-FOG test equipment, we offer a full range of accelerated exposure laboratory testing services in our fully-equipped laboratories in Florida and Germany.
Q-Lab corrosion tests are used for quality control, material certification, exterior durability studies, and predictions. Q-Lab can also act as an unbiased third party wherever third-party verification of test results is required. See our Test Services brochure for more information on our accelerated corrosion testing capabilities.
Fast Results
Although actual outdoor exposures are an ideal way to test your products, sometimes you can't afford to wait a year or two for real-time test results. We can give you fast and reliable corrosion test data using our large array of Q‑FOG accelerated corrosion laboratory testers. Whether you’re running simple salt spray tests or advanced automotive cyclic corrosion tests, Q‑Lab experts can help you set up a successful accelerated laboratory testing program.
